method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every archived terms/help paragraph matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand; sanction clauses re-read in the full text

facts.text: GOAT may 'disallow or block any Trader from participating in the program for any reason, in the Company's sole and absolute discretion'; several prohibited practices are 'as determined by the Company in its sole and absolute discretion', with forfeiture of associated profits or payouts.
Trades closed faster than the minimum holding time: 'Profits from those trades are not included in payout calculations, while losses still count.'
An account closed because GOAT judges the trading style unsuitable, without any other violation, is refunded in full.
1-Step and 2-Step models: no consistency rule (Instant GOAT 15%).
